 Flyers at Blue Jackets projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 14, 2026 
 Link copied 
 FLYERS (5-10-6) at BLUE JACKETS (7-10-0) 
 7 p.m. ET; CBJHN, CBJNHL, NBCSP 
 Flyers projected lineup 
 Michael Bunting -- Christian Dvorak -- Owen Tippett
 Tyson Foerster -- Trevor Zegras -- Travis Konecny
 Porter Martone -- Noah Cates -- Matvei Michkov
 Denver Barkey -- Sean Couturier -- Noel Acciari
 Travis Sanheim -- Jamie Drysdale
 Cam York -- Oliver Bonk
 Nick Seeler -- Rasmus Ristolainen
 Joseph Woll
 Dan Vladar
 Scratched: Simon Benoit, David Jiricek, Cole Knuble 
 Injured: Nikita Grebenkin (back) 
 Blue Jackets projected lineup 
 Matthew Knies -- Luca Del Bel Belluz -- Kent Johnson
 Dmitri Voronkov -- Adam Fantilli -- Valeri Nichushkin
 Cole Sillinger -- Charlie Coyle -- Mathieu Olivier
 Ryan Lomberg -- Jack Williams -- Steven Lorentz 
 Zach Werenski -- Damon Severson
 Ivan Provorov -- Dante Fabbro 
 Jake Christiansen -- Denton Mateychuk
 Jet Greaves
 Cam Talbot
 Scratched: Erik Gudbranson 
 Injured: Isac Lundestrom (lower body), Conor Garland (upper body), Sean Monahan (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Each team held an optional morning skate. … The Flyers will dress the same 18 skaters they used in a 3-2 overtime loss at the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday. ... Woll will start after Vladar made 21 saves at Edmonton. … Blue Jackets coach Rick Bowness will miss a second straight game because of a health issue; assistant Don Granato will run the staff from behind the bench. … Monahan, a forward, was injured in a 3-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday; Del Bel Belluz will replace him in the lineup.
